name: Glycine
evidence_snapshot: Small human sleep trial; GlyNAC results are combination-intervention evidence, not isolated glycine.

name: Magnesium bisglycinate
evidence_snapshot: Small sleep-related effect in one RCT; elemental magnesium dose must be distinguished from compound mass.

name: Creatine monohydrate
evidence_snapshot: Cognition reviews diverge; effects depend on outcome and population.

name: Taurine
evidence_snapshot: One human RCT studied blood-pressure outcomes in prehypertension.

name: Choline
evidence_snapshot: Prenatal feeding study; cannot be extrapolated to adult memory claims.

name: L-5-methyltetrahydrofolate
evidence_snapshot: Homocysteine biomarker evidence in healthy volunteers; not a human longevity trial.

name: Vitamin B12
evidence_snapshot: Meta-analysis found no general cognitive improvement in people without overt deficiency.

name: Vitamin D3
evidence_snapshot: VITAL large trial did not reduce the primary cancer or major cardiovascular event outcomes.

name: Vitamin K2 MK-7
evidence_snapshot: Three-year RCT assessed bone-density outcomes in postmenopausal women.

name: Trimethylglycine
evidence_snapshot: Higher gram-scale doses reduced homocysteine in a small crossover RCT; clinical endpoint not established.

name: Nicotinamide riboside
evidence_snapshot: Short-term RCT increased markers of NAD+ metabolism; not human lifespan evidence.

name: Coenzyme Q10
evidence_snapshot: Q-SYMBIO studied adjunctive use in chronic heart failure; not general-population longevity.

name: Pyrroloquinoline quinone
evidence_snapshot: Small 12-week cognition RCT; formulation and dose matter.

name: Spermidine
evidence_snapshot: 12-month phase 2b RCT found no significant difference on primary memory outcome.

name: Quercetin
evidence_snapshot: Meta-analysis studied blood-pressure change, not longevity.

name: Trans-resveratrol
evidence_snapshot: Human metabolic RCTs include negative findings; no proof of lifespan extension.

name: Calcium alpha-ketoglutarate
evidence_snapshot: Human healthy-aging evidence not yet curated in this initial dataset; entry intentionally pending.
